blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An anti-Marcos coalition held a rally at the Edsa Shrine on Monday, September 21, marking the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law. The protesters also criticized the Supreme Court’s recent decision to overturn former first lady Imelda R. Marcos‘ conviction in graft cases involving alleged ill-gotten wealth. Monday’s rally also marked the second iteration of Sept. 21 protests which began last year over a multi-billion corruption scandal involving flood control projects.
